It may improve its Wind score with 'The Elven War Horse recovers Wind in the same way a character recovers fatigue, time or damage. It can also use its own Strength check as an action, automatically causing it to lose at least one Wind, with no check needed. When the Elven War Horse runs out of Wind, it mount becomes Blown and is in danger of dying. Any time your Elven War Horse would lose Wind while Blown, instead it makes and Average (2d) Ride (Ag) check or Handle Animal (2d) check, or your horse makes an Average (2d) Strength check. If you fail the test, your Elven War Horse loses Wind. The Elven War Horse Rule for mounts are covered in more detail in Chapter 6 of Omens of War, beginning on page 42. You may purchase a permanent +1 maximum Wind for your Elven War Horse, for 1 advance. The Elven War Horse is Swift and Fast, and it gets a free movement manoeuvre on its to the normal extra Trick for your Elven War Horse once during your career as 1 career advance each; the talents applies both to you and the mount.
